assay_or_result: KLK14 induces PAR2/F2RL1-dependent calcium, ERK, and proliferation responses; PAR2 blocking antibody reduces the response.
limitations: Proteolytic activation is receptor-dependent function rather than equilibrium binding.

assay_or_result: The JBC study shows KLK4 initiates intracellular signaling through PAR2/F2RL1, with co-expression and receptor-dependent signaling assays.
limitations: The active ligand is proteolytically generated KLK4 and the mechanism is cleavage/activation, not conventional reversible binding.

assay_or_result: Mature KLK5 activates recombinant PAR2/F2RL1 in receptor reporter assays with direct protease activity measurements.
limitations: Activity depends on mature enzyme preparation and receptor cleavage-site context.

assay_or_result: Kallikrein-6 produces PAR1/F2R-dependent calcium and signaling responses in neural cells, with pharmacologic and receptor-dependent controls.
limitations: The study emphasizes receptor-dependent signaling rather than direct binding and includes cell-type-specific PAR responses.

assay_or_result: The cited study reports kallikrein-6 signaling through PAR2/F2RL1 in astrocyte assays alongside PAR1-dependent effects.
limitations: Cell-type and assay differences separate PAR1 and PAR2 responses; no stable binding measurement is required for this receptor-dependent verdict.

assay_or_result: Mature KLK7 activates recombinant PAR2/F2RL1 in reporter assays with direct protease activity measurements.
limitations: Activity depends on mature enzyme preparation and receptor cleavage-site context.

assay_or_result: Primary L1CAM studies demonstrate homophilic L1CAM binding and cell adhesion, with neural functional consequences.
limitations: L1CAM can also engage heterophilic partners; this verdict is specifically for the homophilic interaction.

assay_or_result: Galectin-9/CD44 interaction is tested in regulatory T-cell systems and linked to receptor-associated stability and suppressive function.
limitations: Glycosylation and CD44 isoform context can affect the interaction.

assay_or_result: Binding assays with TIM-3/HAVCR2 extracellular domains and immune-cell functional studies support Galectin-9 engagement of TIM-3 and downstream apoptosis or inhibitory signaling.
limitations: Reported activity depends on receptor glycosylation and species/construct; later literature disputes some TIM-3 receptor interpretations.

assay_or_result: Affinity chromatography and protein-disulfide-isomerase identification show Galectin-9 binding to cell-surface P4HB and regulation of the redox environment.
limitations: P4HB is a multifunctional surface-associated protein rather than a canonical signaling receptor in all contexts.

assay_or_result: Galectin-9 affinity experiments identify CD45/PTPRC association and B-cell signaling studies connect the interaction to modulation of the BCR signal.
limitations: CD45 isoform and cell-surface glycosylation context are not uniform across assays.

assay_or_result: Biochemical and structural studies show LIF binding LIFR and recruitment of gp130/IL6ST to form the signaling receptor complex.
limitations: Species and receptor stoichiometry vary across structural and cellular assays.

assay_or_result: SALM5/LRFN5 binds LAR-family receptor tyrosine phosphatases including PTPRD in splice-dependent interaction assays and regulates synapse development/function.
limitations: Binding and function depend on extracellular splice inserts and neuronal context.

assay_or_result: SALM5/LRFN5 interaction studies include PTPRF/LAR and connect the complex to presynaptic differentiation and synaptic function.
limitations: Binding depends on receptor splice isoform and extracellular domain composition.

assay_or_result: SALM5/LRFN5 binds PTPRS in splice-dependent interaction assays and affects synapse development and AMPA-related function.
limitations: Binding depends on receptor splice insert and neuronal assay context; the packet DOI itself is mismatched.

assay_or_result: Primary studies show membrane lymphotoxin-alpha1beta2 binding LTbetaR/LTBR using receptor-Fc and cellular assays, with receptor signaling consequences.
limitations: The ligand is a membrane-anchored heterotrimer and receptor binding is sensitive to oligomeric presentation.

assay_or_result: Alpha4beta7 integrin mediates lymphocyte binding to purified or cell-expressed MAdCAM-1, with blocking antibodies and divalent-cation activation controls.
limitations: The principal evidence is adhesion/cell binding rather than an isolated equilibrium affinity measurement.

assay_or_result: MIF binds CD74, and CD44 is required for MIF-induced ERK activation in transfected and cellular assays, supporting the CD74/CD44 receptor complex.
limitations: CD74 is the binding chain and CD44 is a signaling co-receptor; the composite is not a single covalent receptor.

assay_or_result: P0/MPZ biochemical and structural studies demonstrate homophilic adhesion/oligomerization and define interfaces affected by glycosylation and mutation.
limitations: Assays include oligomerization and myelin adhesion contexts rather than a conventional soluble receptor assay.

assay_or_result: Radioligand binding and affinity labeling identify ACVR2B as a myostatin receptor; coexpression with TGFBR1/ALK5 forms the signaling complex and induces Smad2/3 phosphorylation.
limitations: The assayed ligand is mature processed myostatin dimer and receptor stoichiometry/latent-complex processing vary by system.

assay_or_result: Human nectin-1/PVRL1 and CD96 ectodomains were tested by ELISA and SPR, with the CD96 site mapped to the nectin-1 V domain; transfected K562/NK-92 assays provided receptor-dependent function.
limitations: The paper directly assays human proteins; mouse CD96-nectin-1 binding is discussed from prior work rather than tested here.

assay_or_result: Purified nectin ectodomains were compared by kinetic binding assays and cell assays; nectin-1/nectin-3 is an exact V-to-V heterophilic adhesion interaction with measured affinity.
limitations: Affinity depends on nectin isoform presentation and cis/trans context.

assay_or_result: Purified nectin ectodomains were compared by kinetic binding assays and cell assays; nectin-1/nectin-4 is an exact V-to-V heterophilic adhesion interaction with measured affinity.
limitations: Affinity is substantially weaker than nectin-1/nectin-3 and depends on ectodomain presentation.

assay_or_result: The cited nectin primary study explicitly reports nectin-3 binding nectin-2, and the ectodomain/cell adhesion work supports a direct heterophilic trans interaction.
limitations: Nectin/PVR nomenclature and affinity depend on species and ectodomain orientation.

assay_or_result: The primary nectin study explicitly reports nectin-3 binding PVR/CD155 in the heterophilic nectin trans-interaction network.
limitations: The cited work is primarily biochemical/adhesion evidence and does not establish immune-receptor signaling for this pair.

assay_or_result: NEGR1 homophilic binding was tested with soluble NEGR1-Fc on NEGR1-expressing cells, alongside cell aggregation and glycosylation-mutant assays.
limitations: The strongest direct binding assay uses human NEGR1; GPI anchoring and glycosylation affect surface delivery and interaction strength.

assay_or_result: NRG1 stimulation was tested in cells expressing ERBB2/ERBB3; receptor heterodimerization and reciprocal receptor phosphorylation were directly measured, with ERBB3 identified as the ligand-binding partner and ERBB2 as the kinase partner.
limitations: NRG1 isoform and ERBB splice-form context can change potency and dimer behavior.

assay_or_result: NRG1 stimulation was tested in cells expressing ERBB2/ERBB4; heterodimerization and receptor phosphorylation were directly measured, including ERBB2 trans-phosphorylation by ERBB4.
limitations: NRG1 isoform and ERBB splice-form context can change potency and dimer behavior.

assay_or_result: The primary study identifies NRG1 as a ligand of ERBB3 and measures NRG1-dependent signaling in ERBB2/ERBB3 cells, including receptor phosphorylation.

assay_or_result: The primary study identifies NRG1 as a ligand of ERBB4 and measures NRG1-dependent signaling in ERBB2/ERBB4 cells, including receptor phosphorylation.
limitations: ERBB4 isoform and kinase-status context affects the measured phosphorylation pattern.

assay_or_result: NRG1 EGF-like domain binding to integrin alpha6beta4 was tested directly by cell adhesion/ELISA-type assays and linked by mutagenesis to ternary integrin-NRG1-ERBB3 signaling.
limitations: This is an auxiliary integrin/co-receptor interaction, not a replacement for canonical ERBB ligand binding.

assay_or_result: NRG1 EGF-like domain binding to integrin alphavbeta3 was tested by recombinant binding, cell adhesion, and SPR; binding-site mutation reduced NRG1-induced ERBB3 phosphorylation and signaling.
limitations: This is an auxiliary integrin/co-receptor interaction, not a replacement for canonical ERBB ligand binding.

assay_or_result: The primary Nature study states that the NRG2 EGF-like domain binds ErbB3 and changes ErbB receptor tyrosine-phosphorylation profiles in cell assays.
limitations: NRG2 alpha/beta isoforms can differ in potency and the submitted symbol does not specify an isoform.

assay_or_result: NRG2 EGF-like domain binding to ErbB4 is reported in the primary Nature study; NRG2beta ErbB4 phosphorylation and IL-3-independent functional coupling are directly tested in the follow-up study.
limitations: NRG2 alpha and beta have different ErbB4 affinity and efficacy.

assay_or_result: Calsyntenin-3 directly binds Nrxn1 alpha and beta ectodomains in solid-phase, SPR, pulldown, and cell-surface assays; splice-site-4-positive Nrxn1 variants also rescue Clstn3 synaptogenic function.
limitations: Binding and synaptogenic activity depend on Nrxn isoform and splice site 4; the 2020 paper notes prior methodological disagreement.

assay_or_result: The cited primary studies directly test LRRTM2 binding to neurexin-1, including affinity/cell adhesion work and a crystal structure of the Nrxn1beta-LRRTM2 complex.

assay_or_result: The 2020 primary study directly tests Nrxn2beta with SS4-positive variants in rescue of Clstn3 synaptogenic activity, while direct biochemical binding is shown most explicitly for Nrxn1 alpha/beta.

species_support: human PTPmu constructs/cells; conserved mammalian R2B structural context
assay_or_result: PTPmu/PTPRM expression induced cell aggregation, PTPmu-coated beads bound PTPmu ectodomain/cells, and the extracellular MAM-Ig-FN domains form a homophilic adhesion interface.

species_support: mouse hippocampal neurons and mouse brain; rat hippocampal follow-up
assay_or_result: TrkC/NTRK3 bound PTPsigma/PTPRS with high affinity in Fc/cell assays, and blocking antibody/knockdown disrupted bidirectional excitatory synapse differentiation; NT-3 modulated the complex in rat neurons.

assay_or_result: PVR-Fc stained CD226-expressing cells and PVR expression enhanced CD226-dependent NK lysis; soluble CD226 binding and antibody blockade supported PVR-CD226 adhesion in endothelial transmigration.

species_support: human PVR/TIGIT structural and cellular systems

assay_or_result: PYY binds cloned Y4/PPYR1 in transfected CHO cells with nanomolar affinity.

assay_or_result: Secretin binds cloned SCTR and elicits cAMP/calcium signaling; receptor-domain studies confirm ligand binding and Gs activation.
limitations: The receptor is a class-B GPCR homodimer; species and assay systems differ.

assay_or_result: L-selectin binds glycosylated CD34 and supports leukocyte rolling/homing assays.

assay_or_result: Full-length Sema3C induces endothelial collapse in a PLXND1- and neuropilin-dependent assay; Sema3C also drives PLXND1-dependent cellular responses.

assay_or_result: Expression cloning, Sema4A-Fc binding/blockade, and Tim-2 phosphorylation identify mouse Tim-2 as a Sema4A receptor and link it to T-cell activation.

assay_or_result: Sema6D binds Plexin-A1 and Plexin-A1-dependent cardiac morphogenesis assays establish receptor-dependent function.

assay_or_result: Sema6D signaling uses a Plexin-A1/VEGFR2-KDR complex in the conotruncal segment, with developmental effects.

assay_or_result: Siglec-1/sialoadhesin binds sialylated lymphocyte counter-receptors including CD43/Spn in cell-adhesion assays.
limitations: Recognition depends on terminal sialylation and glycan presentation, not only the Spn polypeptide.

assay_or_result: SLURP2 binds nicotinic receptor subunits and modulates alpha3beta2 nAChR currents in oocyte electrophysiology.

assay_or_result: SLURP2 modulates alpha4beta2 nAChR currents and interacts with the corresponding receptor subunits.

assay_or_result: SLURP2 modulates alpha3beta2 and alpha4beta2 nAChR currents, both containing beta2.
